problem: English 'won't bother with you again' (and the prompt) do not match 相信 = trust.
suggested_fix: English: Okay. If you dare to cheat me, I won't trust you again. | Prompt: Say if he dares to cheat you, you will not trust him again.

problem: 廣播 is a radio/TV broadcast; 'go and watch them broadcast' with a ticket needed treats it like a live show.
Being angry because someone is 'not trying to praise' you does not make sense; the three lines do not cohere for 表揚.
說話咁多 is Mandarin-style (說話 is a noun in Cantonese, not a verb taking 咁多); also 你哋/我哋 plural vs 'her' in prompts.
suggested_fix: 喂，喺圖書館，你哋唔好{W}咁嘈呀！ (checker: passes T4)

problem: 'The sun is strong today, let's tidy up' has no logic for 整理 (module is about laundry/sun).
洗房間 / 洗廚房 (wash the bedroom/kitchen) is not natural for 洗.
Taking turns to 曬 for a day / for a week makes no sense for drying things in the sun; module is for chores like 倒垃圾.
Stray 我 in 我你媽媽好叻 is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: 你媽媽好叻，乜嘢都識{W}。 (checker: passes T5)

problem: Stray 我 in 我你媽媽好叻 is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: 你媽媽好叻，乜嘢都識{W}。 (checker: passes T5)

problem: 畀我睇 (let me look at it) for a sound recording; should be 聽.
suggested_fix: 你{W}老師講嘅嘢，就畀我聽。 (checker: passes T3)

problem: 堅持佢 (with pronoun object) is not Cantonese; 堅持 is used bare or with 落去.
suggested_fix: A1 學廣東話好難，但係你要{W}落去呀！ / B 我知，我會{W}落去㗎，唔會停。 / A2 好嘢！你{W}落去，一定會有進步。 (all pass T4)

problem: 堅持佢 (with pronoun object) is not Cantonese; 堅持 is used bare or with 落去.
suggested_fix: A1 做運動好辛苦，你可以每日{W}落去咩？ / B 我試試{W}落去，但係好難。 / A2 唔使驚，我哋大家一齊{W}落去啦！ (all pass T4)

problem: 把握佢 'seize it' with no clear referent is not Cantonese (把握 = certainty / 把握機會).
'There are so many cars, how do we block the traffic?' makes no sense for 阻住.
english_slot 'send' is wrong for 派 here (give out / hand out gifts at a party).
suggested_fix: change english_slot of 1874 to 'hand out' (or 'give out')

problem: B asks why he does not like injections 'now', but A never said so; reply does not follow A1.
suggested_fix: 你係咪好驚{W}呀？唔使驚喎。 | English: Are you scared of getting an injection? There's no need to be. | Prompt: Ask him if he is scared of getting an injection and say there is no need. (passes T3)

problem: Bare 影 for 'take a photo' (no 相) is unnatural; 我想影 / 一齊影啦.
Bare 影 ('成日想影', '畀佢影一個鐘') is not natural without 相.
Bare 影 ('開始影', '我一直都好想影') is not natural without 相.
頂 does not mean lifting/holding up one side of a table (抬); 頂呢邊 / 一齊頂呢張枱 is wrong.
起 is for building structures (起屋); a table is 整/造, not 起.
English 'knock the door' should be 'knock on the door' in every line.
suggested_fix: use 'knock on the door' in A1/B/A2 and prompts

problem: 用遮擋住佢: 遮 needs a classifier, and 遮擋 reads as a compound.
suggested_fix: 你拎支遮{W}住佢啦。 (passes T3; A2 likewise 好呀，我拎支遮{W}住太陽。)

problem: 拎遮擋住太陽: 遮 needs a classifier and reads as the compound 遮擋.
suggested_fix: 好呀，我拎支遮{W}住太陽。 (passes T3)

problem: 收 means put away / receive, not 'collect' (go and pick up) a bag.
english_slot 'rob' is wrong: the lines are kids grabbing things (搶 = grab/snatch), 'you mustn't rob' is unnatural.
'Why do you take off your hat even at home?' is backwards (people do not wear hats at home); A2 does not follow.
脫眼鏡 is not usual HK Cantonese (除眼鏡 / 除低眼鏡).
'There is a meeting tomorrow, does anyone oppose?' has no object of opposition.
suggested_fix: 老細想聽日加班，有冇人{W}呀？ (passes T4)

problem: 'hard to guess this matter / need more time to guess' is odd for 猜 (module is for evaluate/analyse).
體驗 pressure ('how do you experience this pressure', 'I have to experience it') is not meaningful; pressure is 承受/面對.
恨 for 'hate' (好恨呢份工作) is Mandarin/written; spoken is 憎/唔鍾意.
恨 for 'hate' (恨嗰次旅行) is Mandarin/written; spoken is 憎/唔鍾意.
感激 takes a person; 'appreciate this time' (感激呢段時間) is not Cantonese (珍惜).
Bare 集中 (no 精神/注意力) is unnatural, and B says 'don't be so scared' when A never said scared.
A1 says she has lived here a long time but asks if she wants to get to know the place; A2 treats her as new.
suggested_fix: 你啱啱搬嚟呢度，有冇想{W}呢個地方呀？ (passes T4)

problem: 懷念 is for remembering the past/the dead; missing an absent person is 掛住/想念.
好缺少經驗 is written style; spoken is 冇乜經驗.
'If it really will belong to us, we'll buy it' is circular; 屬於 does not fit buying a flat.
Spoken Cantonese is 忍唔住; 忍不住 is the Mandarin/written form (word-list issue).
Prompt says 'when she is about to arrive' but the line is 一到達 (as soon as she arrives).
suggested_fix: Prompt: Tell her to call you as soon as she arrives and say you will wait.

problem: Running away from rain/wind (逃) is not a natural situation; 逃 = flee/escape.
english_slot 'go through' implies entering the station; 經過 = pass (by).
Bare 逛 is Mandarin; Cantonese says 行街 (逛 alone as a verb is not spoken HK Cantonese).
A says 'when we're on holiday', then B asks if the boss will allow leave; contradictory.
拐彎 is Mandarin; HK Cantonese says 轉彎 (word-list issue).
Signing up is not something that takes the whole week or makes you tired; lines are about a chore/study.
炒魷魚 is active (to fire); 'get fired' needs 畀人/俾人 before it (會炒魷魚 reads as 'will fire someone').
suggested_fix: A1 公司最近生意唔好，我好驚會畀人{W}。 / B 唔使驚，你做得好，點會畀人{W}呀？ / A2 你講得啱，真係畀人{W}，我就快啲搵工。 (all pass T4)

problem: 你唔好唔記得出差 ('don't forget to go on a business trip') is odd; B already said she has to go at seven.
suggested_fix: 咁我哋聽日一齊{W}，你唔好遲到呀。 (passes T4)

problem: 'I have something to say, I want to respect you' is a non sequitur for 尊重.
suggested_fix: 我有啲嘢想同你講，我好{W}你。 (passes T4)

problem: 邀請佢 has no object (invite him to what?); reads incomplete.
'After work' tomorrow vs 'three o'clock' (three o'clock is not after work).
suggested_fix: B 我建議七點{W}，人少啲，好行啲。 / A2 好，我哋七點{W}，我買嘢畀你食。 (pass T4)

problem: 聊天 is Mandarin; Cantonese is 傾偈.
'Think it through before you save' is meaningless; 節約 is a habit, not a one-off decision (also prompt 'before he save' ungrammatical).
提錢完 is wrong word order (should be 提完錢).
suggested_fix: 好，{W}之後我哋仲可以去食嘢。 (passes T5)

problem: 換錢完 is wrong word order (should be 換完錢).
suggested_fix: 好，{W}之後我哋仲可以去食嘢。 (passes T5)

problem: 交租完 is wrong word order (should be 交完租).
suggested_fix: 係呀，{W}之後，剩返好少錢。 (passes T5)

problem: 寄 with no object ('we both have to post this month') makes no sense; the module is for 捐.
Sentence-initial 竟然 (竟然我哋快啲出門) is Mandarin-style and illogical; in Cantonese it follows the subject.
suggested_fix: A1 我哋快啲出門，{W}冇遲到。 / B 今日路上面{W}冇塞車，我哋好順利。 / A2 我{W}冇遲到，唔係老闆又鬧我。 (all pass T4)

problem: 唔通你識㗎？ is wrong: 唔通 expects a negative answer; B has just said she does not know.
suggested_fix: 我真係唔識，等陣，{W}你都唔識咩？教我啦。 (passes T5)

problem: 更貴 with no comparison ('this shirt is even more expensive', B 'I also think even more expensive') is unnatural; 更 is written, spoken 仲.
實在安靜 is Mandarin usage; Cantonese 實在 means honest.
English 'get a ride' vs prompt 'catch the bus' disagree (搭唔到車).
suggested_fix: English: Really? Yesterday I almost couldn't catch a bus. (or change prompt to 'get a ride')

problem: 相當好食 is written/Mandarin style; spoken is 幾好食/好好食.
應該往往多謝佢 is ungrammatical; 往往 describes tendencies, cannot follow 應該.
suggested_fix: 係呀，佢{W}幫人，我哋都應該多謝佢。 (passes T4)

problem: 'As long as it arrives immediately' is odd for 立刻.
suggested_fix: 好，只要{W}寄出去就好喇。 (passes T4, also fine for 按時)

problem: 我而家及時打 (now + promptly) is odd.
suggested_fix: 好，我{W}打電話畀佢，你放心。 (passes T4)

problem: The airport being five minutes away is implausible.
suggested_fix: A1 去車站要{W}，你要快啲出門。 / A2 我哋坐車{W}就到車站喇。 (pass T4)

problem: English 'Yes, and but today' is garbled.
suggested_fix: English: Yes, but today I'm paying, so don't be shy.

problem: 'doesn't seem a bad person' should be 'doesn't seem like a bad person'.
english_slot 'pile' gives 'One pile of friends are going together'; unnatural English for 堆 here.
嗰圈 as an expensive 'special' item is unclear.
上頓冇咁好玩 ('last meal wasn't as fun') is odd for a meal.
suggested_fix: 我都係，上{W}冇咁好食。 (passes T3)

problem: 對喎 is a realisation ('oh right'); used to confirm a plan it is odd.
'I want to try it too' is odd for Watsons (module is written for Octopus).
'Have you been to Asia yet, is it fun?' / 'Asia is great fun' is odd for a continent.
別人 means other people in general, not the rest of our group; 別人仲未到 / 別人話塞車 is wrong (其他人/人哋).
呢度嘅全部蛋撻 is Mandarin-style order; Cantonese puts 全部 after.
suggested_fix: 呢度啲蛋撻{W}都好食喎，你試一下。 (passes T3)

problem: 任何 is written/Mandarin; spoken uses 乜嘢/邊個…都 (word-list issue).
任何 is written/Mandarin; spoken uses 乜嘢/邊個…都 (word-list issue).
B said she did not delete it; 'don't delete my things again' contradicts.
suggested_fix: 搵到喇！{W}之前，記得問吓我啦。 (passes T4)

problem: English 'see what happens' does not match 睇點算 (see what to do).
suggested_fix: English: Right, I'll ask the boss now and see what to do.
